config.general.title: Workers & Resources · General
config.detect.enable.desc:
Detect the file type by **path and content** when a file is opened.

Files in this game have no exclusive extension — scripts are `.txt`, configs are `.ini`, and the same name can mean different things (`script.ini` is everywhere; some are scenario lists, some are terrain parameters). So type detection has to work this way.

Turn it off and you have to switch the language mode by hand (`Ctrl+Shift+P` → Change Language Mode).
config.language.desc:
Which language the **hover / completion / outline text and descriptions** use.

`auto` (default) = follow the VS Code display language. You can also put a language directory name, for example `zh-CN` or `en-US`.

Note: this does **not** affect the settings titles/descriptions, command names or the extension name — those follow the VS Code display language (the host replaces them while scanning the extension manifest; an extension cannot change them at runtime).

When a symbol has no description in the selected language it falls back to the default language `zh-CN`; if there is still none, only the signature is shown.
config.pyrois.title: Workers & Resources · Pyrois script
config.pyrois.completion.enable.desc: Enable completion for instructions / structs / struct fields / constants / functions.
config.pyrois.hover.enable.desc: Show the signature and description when hovering instructions, structs, constants, functions, struct fields, and language keywords such as `defineFunction` / `if` / `for` / `include`.
config.pyrois.outline.enable.desc: Show the functions and structs defined in the script in the Outline / Go to Symbol view.
config.pyrois.definition.enable.desc:
`Ctrl`+click (or `F12`) jumps to the definition.

The file-name argument of `include("file")`, and of `Script_Exists` / `Script_StartNew` / `Script_DestroyByName`, opens that file directly; variables, functions and structs in the same file jump to their declaration; instructions, struct fields and methods follow the `include("SOVIETInstructions.txt")` at the top of the script into the game's own API table.
config.btf.title: Workers & Resources · BTF files
config.btf.view.maxEntries.desc:
How many translations the "BTF text view" lists at most.

The text view is an ordinary text document; too many entries (hundreds of thousands of lines) slow the editor down.

**The review view (the one you get by double-clicking a `.btf`) is not affected** — it renders on demand, and **exporting JSON / CSV is never limited**.

`0` or a negative number means no limit.
